content.text: Kritisch-Watten (also known as Bayerisch Watten or Kritisch Warp) is a popular Alpine variant of the trick-taking game Watten, widely played in Bavaria, Tyrol (Austria), and South Tyrol. It is distinguished by the presence of 'Kritische Karten' (Criticals or Kritten)â€”permanent trumps that rank above all other cards, including the elected trump suit and rank. The game is highly social, utilizing secret signals between partners and psychological bluffing.
Watten dates back to the early 19th Century, allegedly popularized by soldiers during the Napoleonic Wars. 'Kritisch-Watten' emerged as the more competitive variant in Alpine taverns.
33 cards in Tyrol (including the 'Weli'). Hearts, Leaves, Acorns, Bells. Standard Ranks: Sau (Ace), K, O, U, 10, 9, 8, 7.
